in_hindi.name: जुहैरा

in_pashto.name: جوهره

data.cultural_impact: The name Juhayrah carries a rich cultural legacy. In Islamic tradition, Juhayrah is the name of a valiant contemporary of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). This lady hailed from the noble tribe of Quraish and fearlessly defended the Prophet during various battles, including the Battle of Uhud. Despite her husband's opposition to the Prophet and Islam, Juhayrah remained steadfastly committed to her faith, demonstrating her resilience and dedication to Islamic values through her actions. Her story offers an inspiring testament to courage, loyalty, and the enduring power of faith in the face of adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Juhayrah holds deep meaning as it refers to one who glorifies Allah through their actions, thoughts, and words. Just as the historical Juhayrah personified this quality in her life, those who bear this name are encouraged to similarly embody these noble virtues. By constantly striving to glorify Allah, individuals may experience a greater sense of closeness to their Creator and strive towards a more purposeful, sacred existence. In the words of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), "The most beloved things to Allah are sincere intention and deed." Thus, bearing the name Juhayrah may serve as a daily reminder for each individual to engage in sincere actions that bring them closer to their faith and their ultimate goal of living a life pleasing to Allah.
